title: 光纤在线 — 国产AI芯片破局：国产TCB设备首次完成CoWoS封装工艺测试
notes: Archived 2026-10-07; article dated 2025-03-14 10:33:45 on its own page. Industry trade portal (光纤在线) relaying PrecisioNext's own statements: completion of CoWoS-L test sampling for a domestic AI chip (described as the first such breakthrough for a domestic TCB tool), the Loong platform's ±1μm chip-placement precision at 450°C, compatibility with 12-inch wafer-level and 620×620mm panel-level packaging, a stated capability to 'support HBM stacking' among its full-process coverage, a forward target of ±0.3μm precision for a next-generation Fluxless TCB tool (not yet achieved), and the SEMICON China booth description labelling the Loong line 'the sole domestic HBM/CoWoS bonding equipment'.
